items.briefing:
Australian regulators are flagging that home battery systems (like rooftop solar storage) are now considered a cybersecurity compliance issue, meaning organisations that use or manage these systems may face new obligations. Separately, police agencies globally continue to struggle with funding and resourcing to tackle cybercrime effectively, which is a reminder that businesses shouldn't rely solely on law enforcement to protect them.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation uses smart energy systems or home battery technology on-site, check with your IT or facilities team whether those devices are covered under your cybersecurity policy.
